environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) within a VPC that has NO NAT gateway, NO VPC endpoints for S3/DynamoDB/SSM, and NO internet gateway route in the subnet's route table. The only route table entry is the local VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16 -> local). RDS PostgreSQL is accessible via a VPC-internal DNS endpoint. The ECS tasks use awsvpc networking mode with a security group that allows inbound on port 8080 from the internal ALB only, and egress is restricted to the RDS security group on port 5432 and the ALB health check response path. DNS resolution is provided by Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint within the VPC. The database user has SELECT-only privileges scoped to the inventory_items table via PostgreSQL row-level security policies.

config.internet_gateway_route: not present in subnet route table
config.security_group_egress: allow TCP 5432 to sg-rds only; allow TCP ephemeral to sg-alb only; deny all other
config.db_user_privileges: SELECT on inventory_items only, pg_catalog read revoked
config.network_acl: inbound: allow from 10.0.0.0/16 only; outbound: allow to 10.0.0.0/16 only
